### Justice Left to God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/justice-left-to-god
Passage: 2 Samuel 3:28–29
Points:
- David publicly condemned Joab for murdering Abner and pronounced generational curses upon Joab's house.
- Although David declared his own innocence, he failed to exercise his royal authority to punish Joab.
- Political pragmatism and fear of his violent commanders likely kept David from enforcing God's law.
- Leaving Joab unpunished was a failure of the king's duty to administer earthly justice.
- Governing leaders are called by God to restrain evil and punish wrongdoers rather than compromise.
